items.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996
items.q: Teddy had been there in China with Buck Clayton, Carlton Roberts and that bunch.

ctx.x: Had he been there for a while?
Yes he had. Teddy had been there in China with Buck Clayton, Carlton Roberts and that bunch.
That’s right, Buck Clayton was one of the first fellows to go over in that part of the world?
